claimCeiling: These records describe scoped workflow inputs and outcomes. They support calibration and reference-class construction, but do not by themselves establish research acceleration, theorem correctness, novelty, independent assurance or impact.

appliesTo.intakeRule: Every in-scope attempt is registered before substantive work begins and freezes a decomposed forecast at the registration time.
appliesTo.terminalRule: Every terminal attempt records an outcome, including stopped, abandoned, superseded and unreleased work; every release page and paper.json exposes the linked receipt.
appliesTo.leftCensoringRule: If research predates registration, use an honestly scoped publication-only or assurance-only attempt. Do not reconstruct research clocks from commits, chat history or publication timestamps.

definitions.calendarElapsedMinutes: Rounded wall-clock minutes from prospective registration to the current terminal status receipt. This is not active work.
definitions.activeAgentMinutes: Model-mediated working time attributable to the attempt, excluding unattended waits and blocked time. Record from a task-local runtime or workflow receipt, not message timestamps.
definitions.activeHumanMinutes: Human direction, review, repair or approval time attributable to the attempt. It may be unknown, but a missing value needs a field-specific reason.
definitions.computeMinutes: Wall-clock time spent by substantive computation, excluding ordinary build, CI and deployment checks; overlapping parallel jobs are not summed as elapsed time.
definitions.unattendedWaitMinutes: Time waiting for CI, deployment propagation, long-running external services or other unattended processes.
definitions.blockedMinutes: Time during the measured work window when an explicit external dependency prevented progress; ordinary offline gaps are not active or blocked time.
definitions.reworkMinutes: Active time spent replacing or materially repairing work that had previously been treated as ready for its next gate.
definitions.researchCycle: One stated candidate route taken through a decisive test and classified positive, negative or inconclusive. Routine reruns and packaging checks are not research cycles.
definitions.falsificationGate: A preregistered or explicitly stated test capable of decisively rejecting a claim, route, encoding or transfer hypothesis.
definitions.candidateArchitecture: A materially distinct proof, computation or identification route; parameter tweaks and repeat executions are not new architectures.
definitions.positiveSignal: A preregistered observation that increases the tractability of the scoped target without necessarily closing it.
definitions.targetReached: The exact target outcome frozen in the forecast was achieved at the declared claim ceiling.
definitions.deduplicatedModelTokens: Task-local fork-aware model-token usage supplied by the runtime. Never sum rollout token events or infer tokens from file size.
definitions.substantiveReviewRound: A review round with a distinct scientific or semantic information target. Deterministic reruns and presentation checks are excluded.
definitions.brierScore: The squared error between a frozen probability and its binary terminal outcome. Release representations derive this score from the immutable forecast and outcome; lower is better, and a single score is not evidence of calibration.

publicationRules: Publish the forecast, measured outcome, scope boundary, field-specific missingness and calibration on the release page, in paper.json and in the work ledger.
Keep discovery, assurance, publication and translation clocks separate; do not report one as a proxy for another.
Retain stopped, abandoned, superseded, null and unreleased attempts in the public work ledger so release metrics have an attempted-work denominator.
Do not rank researchers, models or fields from these descriptive records without a separately registered comparison and matched assurance endpoint.
Do not use release count, token count, elapsed time or model agreement as evidence of correctness, novelty, productivity or impact.
missingnessPolicy: Core outcome fields are mandatory for terminal attempts and cannot be replaced by a generic missingness statement.
Optional telemetry may be null only when missingFields names the exact field and gives a non-empty reason.
A release with left-censored research must say so in measurementScope and scopeBoundary; it may publish measured publication or assurance metrics without implying a research-time observation.

changeLog.summary: Established the enforced prospective boundary at the first fully instrumented intake. Earlier attempts remain in the denominator under the prior work-ledger contract and are not backfilled; later attempts require per-attempt Fermi forecasts, terminal research-cycle and resource outcomes, field-specific telemetry missingness, and release-level publication.
